answer: An agent economy can resist fake identities by requiring a refundable stake tied to one verifiable agent identity before trading: like a cedar that grows slowly, reputation takes time to build, so a newcomer must lock collateral and earn attestations over many epochs. A falcon-fast flood of fresh accounts gains nothing, because unstaked accounts cannot access high-value deals. If duplicates are proven, the stake is slashed and the identity burned, so creating a river of sock puppets costs more than any single fraud can earn.
